notes.detection: A detection is the centre of a VIIRS pixel (about 375 m across at nadir) flagged as containing one or more fires or other thermal anomalies. It is not a confirmed fire, a fire perimeter or a burned area.
notes.time: acquired_at is the satellite overpass time in UTC (FIRMS acq_date and acq_time), not when a fire started.
notes.summary: Cells count every detection in the window, kept in the list or not. The same fire is often detected on several overpasses and by both satellites, so detections are not a count of fires. frp_sum_mw adds only detections that reported FRP.
notes.window: Each satellite covers the 24 hours before its own retrieval (windows).
